verdicts.reason: Both share the same core flaws: the legal line is enlarged and jammed directly under the headline, above the CTA, so the fine print competes with the message and splits headline from button. The badge and logo are also split to opposite top corners with no shared axis. A's headline runs almost edge to edge with an awkward 'day of / the year' break. B wraps the headline better ('day / of the year') with comfortable margins, but it moves the large translucent planet directly behind the can, which muddies the product silhouette.
